notes: Manufacturer datasheet (ZeeVee) confirms all ports via labeled rear-panel diagram plus a connector table. Power connector is described as a "locking connector" and depicted as a coaxial-style locking DC jack (12VDC, 1A) — mapped to dc-barrel as the closest listed id (note: it is a locking variant, not a plain barrel jack). RS-232 is on a 3-pin phoenix/euroblock terminal block (TX/RX/G), mapped to euroblock connector type (no dedicated rs232-over-euroblock id exists in the list). Analog audio in/out are also phoenix/euroblock terminal blocks (balanced stereo in/out, or unbalanced stereo), mapped to euroblock. IR In/Out are 3.5mm mini-jacks, mapped to trs-3.5 (closest connector id; true IR mini-jacks are not standard audio TRS but this is the nearest match). HDMI IN supports HDMI 2.0a with HDCP 2.2 pass-through, up to 4K60 4:2:0 — graded hdmi-2.0. HDMI OUT is a video loopout/passthrough of the same HDMI input signal (same HDMI 2.0 grade). Ethernet port carries encoded AVoIP media/audio/control traffic over 1Gb with PoE (device is a PoE powered-device on that port in some deployments, but the datasheet also lists a separate dedicated 12VDC power input as included/standard powering method) — graded eth-1g. This is an encoder-only unit (transmitter); a companion ZyPerUHD-D decoder and management platform are required for a full system but are separate products not covered here. A Dante-enabled variant (ZyPerUHD-EA) and wallplate variant exist with different connectors (3.5mm audio jacks, HDMI+VGA wallplate input) — not reflected here since this entry is for the standard rack/wall-mount ZyPerUHD-E. Desktop/wall-mount unit, not rack-mountable (ships with wall-mount brackets), so rackUnits is omitted.
